description_en: Deletes a custom agent from a specified workspace. A successful request indicates that the deletion is accepted. The runtime resources are subsequently cleaned up in the background
description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的自定义智能体。请求成功表示已受理删除，运行资源随后在后台清理
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore delete-custom-agent --workspace-id ws-a1b2c3d4e5f6 --agent-id agent-550e8400e29b41d4a716446655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCustomAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义智能体所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the custom agent. You can obtain it from the response of CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents
parameters.help_zh: 自定义智能体的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取
parameters.name: agent_id

code.description_en: The result code of the request. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 请求结果码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The summary of the custom agent whose deletion is accepted. The runtime resources are subsequently cleaned up in the background
data.description_zh: 已受理删除的自定义智能体摘要。运行资源随后在后台清理

agentId.description_en: The unique identifier of the custom agent. You can obtain it from the response of CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents
agentId.description_zh: 自定义智能体的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取

createMode.description_en: The creation method of the agent. The value is CUSTOM for custom agents
createMode.description_zh: 智能体创建方式。自定义智能体返回 CUSTOM

createdAt.description_en: The time when the agent was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format. A trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone. Fractional seconds may be included
createdAt.description_zh: 智能体创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

deployType.description_en: The deployment method of the agent. Custom agents are deployed and managed by the platform. The value is MANAGED
deployType.description_zh: 智能体部署方式。自定义智能体由平台部署和管理，返回 MANAGED

description.description_en: The description of the agent's purpose
description.example: 提供对话服务的自定义智能体

latestSpecVersion.description_en: The latest configuration version number. Updates with the same configuration may retain the original version number. This field does not indicate that the configuration has taken effect
latestSpecVersion.description_zh: 当前最新配置版本号。相同配置的更新可能保留原版本号；本字段不代表该配置已经生效

name.description_en: The name of the custom agent

runtime.description_en: The compute specifications of the agent. Valid values: INTERACTIVE, STANDARD, and HEAVY
runtime.description_zh: 智能体的计算规格，取值为 INTERACTIVE、STANDARD 或 HEAVY

status.description_en:
The overall status of the agent. Valid values:
Creating: The agent is being created.
Running: The agent is running.
Failed: The agent is in a failed state.
Updating: The agent is being updated.
Deleting: The agent is being deleted.
Deleted: The agent has been deleted.
Call GetCustomAgent to retrieve the latest configuration execution progress
status.description_zh: 智能体整体状态。Creating：创建中；Running：运行中；Failed：失败；Updating：更新中；Deleting：删除中；Deleted：已删除。最新配置执行进度请调用 GetCustomAgent 查询

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was last updated. The time is in ISO 8601 format. A trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone. Fractional seconds may be included
updatedAt.description_zh: 智能体最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom agent belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 自定义智能体所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. The value is 200 if the request is successful
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200

message.description_en: The processing result message of the request. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的处理结果说明。成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates success. A successful creation, update, or deletion does not mean that the background operation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示处理成功；创建、更新或删除成功不代表后台操作已经完成
